name: Amanda Fix
bio:
Amanda Fix (born 2001) is a Canadian actress from Vancouver who made her feature film debut appearing in Broken Diamonds (2021). Fix played in Kung Fu (2021), North of Normal (2022), High School (2022), Daisy Jones & the Six (2023), Orphan Black: Echoes (2023), and Lowlifes (2024).
